patthana23.57:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho atītārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na anāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho anāgatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.57:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na paccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho paccuppannārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ
